question: Which of the following country won the Hopman World Cup 2019?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Switzerland.**____** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Switzerland **won the Hopman World Cup 2019.
 
• Switzerland **won their third Hopman Cup **as Roger Federer and Belinda Bencic beat Germany's Alexander Zverev and Angelique Kerber.
 
• **Belinda Bencic and Roger Federer** are swiss tennis champions.
 
• It was Federer's second Hopman Cup triumph after victory in 2001 alongside then world number one Martina Hingis.
 
• The final was held at the** Perth Arena.**
